content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] program running well on a [product_name] controller with data exchange to Node-RED. However, when I open the same program file with a newer [version_no] and transfer it to a new controller, the VM parameter mapping isn't imported correctly. Node-RED nodes keep switching between online and offline states. Has anyone experienced this or knows what might be wrong?
Consider submitting a support request for further assistance.
Please share the solution here once you find it, so others can learn as well.

I don't have any [version_no] hardware, only [version_no] with a specific firmware. I'm guessing your Node-RED setup uses Snap7. Since [version_no] hardware differs in configuration, it may simply not be compatible with your current implementation. That's why there's an option to select hardware in [product_name] software, so you can choose supported hardware for Node-RED. Snap7 supports two different [product_name] hardware versions, and that's likely what you're running into. New hardware often comes with a new bootloader; when you select the hardware in [product_name] software, the download may use an older bootloader for older devices.
Hi, thanks for your comment. Could you clarify your point? I'm not sure it's possible to upload the old program version to the new controller.

The [product_name] with certain firmware versions has various communication issues. If you're using these firmware releases, try updating to the latest available version, as this resolves many problems. You can download the update from the official source.
Thank you for your reply. Unfortunately, updating to the newest firmware did not fix the issue.

It seems you might be experiencing a connection problem rather than an issue with VM parameter mapping. Double-check your controller's IP address and Node-RED settings to ensure they're aligned with the new hardware configuration. I've completed a similar migration and it worked as expected.

Hi, thank you for your response. Did you manage to get it working with the updated controller? My program runs flawlessly on the previous version, but loses connection after upgrading. The IP settings and parameter mapping should be correct since they work with the older setup. I've attached a short video showing the device connecting briefly before disconnecting again.

analysis.insight_summary: Users migrating from older to newer [product_name] modules, especially changing hardware versions, are experiencing major connectivity issues between controllers and Node-RED. Primary concerns involve VM parameter mapping and communication reliability. The transition to newer hardware and firmware is proving problematic, as previous workflows on earlier versions operated smoothly. This highlights unexpected hardware and software compatibility challenges during updates.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect backward compatibility and seamless migration between hardware versions, with uninterrupted connectivity between [product_name] modules and Node-RED. They want existing parameter mappings and network configurations to remain functional after upgrades.
